name: The product (name not final)
summary: The AI marketing product itself: social posting and paid ads run from any AI chat. 'AdsPilot' is a working name only and is being replaced. Colours and type are taken from the product's own dashboard; adopting them as the product's brand is proposed, and there is deliberately no logo until the name is final.

ownership.note: The owner's own product. Served only to the owner's tenant (BRANDS_OWNER_TENANT_ID).

approval.rule: Nothing here is approved: the name, any logo and the launch identity are the owner's decisions. Until the name is chosen, nothing public carries a product logo or the working name.

sources.note: The dashboard's @theme tokens: colours, system font, 12px cards, 8px controls, 0.92rem semibold buttons.
Why 'AdsPilot' cannot stay: the name is taken.
The product bet and the standing rules (errors say why and how; nothing is called verified until proven).

sources.ref: Proposed for the product from the dashboard's values and the project rules; owner to confirm.

rules: System fonts until a launch identity is chosen: nothing to license, nothing to load.
Labels and help text at 13px or more; body 16px.
Tailwind's 4px steps, as the dashboard uses them; cards pad 20px.

layout.grid: Tailwind breakpoints, single-column forms, card grids that wrap.
rules: Every error says what happened, why, and the numbered steps to fix it (RULES R1).

placeholder.note: No logo exists and the name is not final: 'AdsPilot' is a working name and is taken. This dashed text box is a placeholder, not a logo. Do not design around it, export it, or put it on anything public. When the PRODUCT_NAME setting is set, the placeholder shows that name, still marked as a placeholder.

logo.clearSpace: Not defined until a logo exists.

minSize.note: A placeholder value; set it when a real logo is designed.

do: Write the product name in plain text in the interface until a logo exists.
Read the name from the product setting, never hard-code it.
dont: Never put the working name 'AdsPilot' in a logo, on an ad or on any public image.
Never invent a logo, icon mark or wordmark for the product.
Never borrow another brand's logo (1920 Agency, a platform) as the product's mark.

imagery.style: Real screenshots of the product working: the AI chat, an approval summary, a published post. Dark interface on its own background.
do: Use real screens with real (or clearly labelled demo) data.
Show the approval step: nothing goes live without the user's yes.
dont: No invented results, ROAS figures or customer logos.
No platform logos implying partnership or certification.
No mock-ups of features that are not built.

icons.style: Simple line icons with text labels; status shown in words as well as colour.
rules: Never colour alone for status: OK, Warning and Error carry a word.
Say what happened, why, and how to fix it (RULES R1).
Never call something verified, live or done until it has been proven against the real thing (RULES R4).
Plain words for business owners, not marketing jargon.
The working name never appears in public copy until the name is final.

examples.say: Not published: the Page needs reconnecting. Reconnect it in the dashboard, then try again.
Scheduled for 15:30. You can cancel it until then.

rules: Until the name and identity are final, product ads are drafts only: none is published.
Show the real product (a screen recording or screenshot), the approval step, and one plain benefit.
No claims beyond what is proven live (CURRENT-STATE.md).
